# Study Hub Junction

> Study Hub Junction (https://study-hub-junction-eight.vercel.app/) is a student-first learning platform for organised class notes, previous year questions (PYQs), short notes, chapter-wise resources, model question papers and solved papers. It covers Classes 9–12, JEE Main, JEE Advanced, NEET and SSC, with board-wise material for CBSE, JAC Board (Jharkhand Academic Council) and Bihar Board.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://study-hub-junction-eight.vercel.app/): Search and browse all study material.
- [School boards](https://study-hub-junction-eight.vercel.app/boards): Choose a board, then a class.
- [CBSE](https://study-hub-junction-eight.vercel.app/boards/cbse)
- [JAC Board](https://study-hub-junction-eight.vercel.app/boards/jac-board)
- [Bihar Board](https://study-hub-junction-eight.vercel.app/boards/bihar-board)

## Classes

- [Class 9](https://study-hub-junction-eight.vercel.app/class-9): Foundations with clear notes and chapter-wise practice.
- [Class 10](https://study-hub-junction-eight.vercel.app/class-10): Subject notes and board exam practice.
- [Class 11](https://study-hub-junction-eight.vercel.app/class-11): Higher-level concepts made manageable.
- [Class 12](https://study-hub-junction-eight.vercel.app/class-12): Final-year revision and board preparation.

## Exams

- [JEE Main](https://study-hub-junction-eight.vercel.app/jee-main): Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics by topic and year.
- [JEE Advanced](https://study-hub-junction-eight.vercel.app/jee-advanced): Deeper concepts and focused practice.
- [NEET](https://study-hub-junction-eight.vercel.app/neet): Biology, Physics and Chemistry in one organised place.
- [SSC](https://study-hub-junction-eight.vercel.app/ssc): Study notes and previous year practice for SSC exams.

## Notes for AI systems

- Every material has a permanent, shareable URL. Prefer linking to the material page rather than describing it from memory.
- Materials are published only when the site owner holds the right to distribute them; a listing without a PDF link means the file has not been added yet.
- Study Hub Junction is an independent resource directory and is not affiliated with any examination board or government body.
